point.ramp_mae_mw: mean absolute error of adjacent within-day half-hour differences
point.mean_daily_peak_absolute_error_mw: mean absolute error of daily maxima
point.mean_peak_timing_absolute_error_slots: absolute separation of earliest daily argmax slots
point.daily_mae_p95_mw: 95th percentile of per-day mean absolute errors

interval.coverage: fraction of marginal half-hours with absolute residual <= issued width
interval.absolute_coverage_error: absolute observed coverage minus nominal level
interval.mean_interval_score_mw: width + 2/alpha times distance outside the interval
interval.weighted_interval_score_mw: (0.5 absolute point error + sum(alpha/2 times interval score))/(K+0.5)
interval.repair_max: maximum nesting repair after bounded neural TTA; normalised scale unless labelled MW
interval.rolling_30day_coverage: mean of daily marginal coverage over latest up to 30 available origins

runtime.p50_ms: median latency within the explicitly labelled scope
runtime.p50_speedup: reference median divided by candidate median on the same host and condition
runtime.kv_allocated_bytes: request-local key/value tensor storage, excluding weights/activations/allocator overhead
runtime.process_peak_rss_bytes: Linux interpreter high-water resident memory; fresh-process scope explicitly described
runtime.process_wall_ms: fresh child launch through first prediction, measured by parent
runtime.session_init_ms: ONNX session construction within an already imported process
runtime.quantized_operator_counts: exported operator counts, not percent end-to-end integer execution

service.offered: all scheduled request attempts including rejected or failed attempts
service.completion_within_five_seconds: successful admitted completions within deadline divided by all admitted tickets
service.post_to_result: client-observed POST through successful result retrieval, includes polling
service.reads: successful individual GET duration; failed reads reported separately
service.queue_ms: task admission through lease claim, not full HTTP latency

availability.public_probe: TLS-verified routes and fresh server model computation from one probe host
availability.seven_day_gate: requires real elapsed observations, with individual probe timestamps and failures. A running schedule alone does not pass the gate.

not_claimed: energy or carbon savings without power measurements
paper theorem transfer to adapted NCC
production multi-region uptime from local load tests
